=== HANDOFF #7 — epic e369 (Jira Server/Data Center). READ THIS, THEN #6, THEN #5. ===

WORKTREE /Users/joeoakhart/rebar-jira-family, branch jira-family-seam @ f4ad13c83, clean.
ALWAYS: export PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH"

*** UNCHANGED HEADLINE STATUS: INBOUND IS PROVEN, OUTBOUND IS NOT. J11 [rebar:5200-e04e-246e-4aae]
IS STILL THE EPIC'S CLOSING CONDITION. DO NOT CLOSE THE EPIC WITHOUT IT. ***

CLOSED THIS SESSION
  8c35-1a5e-927b-4644 (J8 ADR), cd78-d877-3d25-4ec3 (--class plan_defect),
  5f48-244c-7063-42d0 (--class plan_defect).
  5f48 needed NO code: its fix had ALREADY landed on main inside commit 36e134401
  ("b4e3: mint DC inbound identities as jira family"), whose message says "Folds in bug 5f48".
  BOTH halves are there — the guard reads `for key in ("accountId", "name")` and
  `_identity_provider_for` asks the backend for `identity_family`. 9/9 held-out tests pass.
  **Closing it UNBLOCKED 5200 (J11).**

THE STACK (bottom to top) — branch jira-family-seam, 4 changes:
  4a828284e  9263  -> Gerrit 1129   LLM +1, Verified pending
  0ef0ea6f5  21fc  -> Gerrit 1130   LLM NONE (see below), Verified pending
  4698764e9  387d  -> Gerrit 1131   LLM +1, Verified pending
  f4ad13c83  7c26  -> Gerrit 1136   LLM +1, Verified pending   [NEW THIS SESSION]

7c26 IMPLEMENTED (change 1136). Binding survives an issue MOVING project: capture the immutable
numeric id at create (`record_jira_id`), and on a 404 re-ask by it (`note_absent_or_rekey`),
re-keying the binding AND the reverse index in one operation instead of retiring a live issue. 13
held-out tests driven END-TO-END through the real absence probe; 4 fail against pre-fix code;
mutation-checked three ways. Full detail on the ticket.
  * `get_issue_by_rest` accepts a NUMERIC ID on both deployments, so NO new transport member was
    needed — which mattered, DC transport had 11 lines of headroom.
  * outbound_differ was at EXACTLY the locked 800 cap and cannot import the concrete store (a
    documented Protocol boundary), so three byte-identical getattr wrappers were collapsed into one
    `_best_effort` to buy the lines. That refactor looks unrelated in the diff — the reason is on
    the ticket and in the commit message.
  * Its [operator-attested] AC is PARTLY UNSETTLEABLE: a project MOVE is not performable through
    pycontribs/jira 3.10.5 (verified at RUNTIME — no move member; `move_to_backlog` is Agile,
    `move_version` is versions) and DC's move is the UI wizard. So what `GET /issue/{oldKey}`
    returns after a real move stays OPEN. Live cells were added for what IS checkable (resolve by
    id; a deleted issue fails by key AND by id). Those need a harness run before 7c26 closes.

*** A REGRESSION IN OUR OWN STACK, FOUND AND FIXED — carry this lesson ***
A full local sweep (run only because CI had stalled) returned 1 failed / 817 passed:
`test_create_one_populates_binding_store` -> `assert None is not None`. 21fc's OWN change caused it.
Its new create gate reads `is_keyless_pending_within_grace` off the store, and that test's double is
a bare `MagicMock`, which answers EVERY member with a TRUTHY Mock — so the gate fired for a ticket
with no pending binding and the create was deferred. I confirmed ownership rather than assuming:
reverting ONLY dispatch_one.py to HEAD~1 left it red (ruling out 7c26), and `git log -S` named
06b8702b1. Fix: the double now answers False, which is what a real store returns. The fix went into
21fc's OWN commit (Gerrit verifies each change independently, so 1130 alone would still have gone
red), which required rebuilding the stack non-interactively — amend 21fc, cherry-pick 387d and 7c26
back on top. ALL THREE Change-Ids survived, so it updated the existing changes.
LESSON: a bare MagicMock is NOT a neutral stand-in. Every new getattr-guarded capability check
silently changes what it answers, and the failure surfaces as an unrelated-looking None. When adding
a gate that consults an OPTIONAL store member, grep the test tree for bare mocks IN THE SAME CHANGE.

INFRASTRUCTURE — VERIFIED HEALTHY, WITH ONE STALL I CLEARED
  * GERRIT + REVIEW BOT: HEALTHY. Server HTTP 200 in 0.29s. The bot voted PASS on 1132 at 00:11:40,
    and on 1141/1140/1136/1131/1129 before that. It is voting normally.
  * GITHUB ACTIONS: HEALTHY. "Gerrit Verified Gate" runs created AFTER mine (22:04, 22:17, 22:40,
    22:45) all completed SUCCESSFULLY in 35-77 min. Push runs finish in 3-5 min.
  * THE STALL WAS MINE, NOT THE FLEET'S: my four runs (30659951798, 30668540449/1953/3617) sat
    in_progress with `updatedAt` frozen for ~2 hours (one for 4.5h). I posted `recheck` on all four
    changes (the documented remedy, CONTRIBUTING.md §2c); the stalled runs CANCELLED and four fresh
    runs started at 00:14 (30675030213/1552/2723/4104). Expect Verified in ~35-77 min.
  * 1130 HAS NO LLM VOTE. Its patchset-4 review hit `[LLM-Review: BLOCK — coverage-gap
    (review-error)]` — an INFRA veto, explicitly "not your code"; docs/review-policy.md says a
    MAINTAINER re-triggers it. **The operator already removed that -1 at 00:11:11**, so 1130 now
    sits at no vote and needs a fresh bot review. Do NOT edit 1130's diff to chase it.

b586 [rebar:b586-2fda-8a15-4260] — PLAN ONLY, 9 REVIEW ROUNDS, STILL BLOCK (round 10 in flight).
NO CODE WRITTEN. The full round-by-round record is a comment on the ticket; the two that matter:
  * The plan would have built a THIRD Retry-After implementation (`_errors.parse_retry_after` +
    `MAX_BACKOFF_S` already exist; `dispatch_one.py:150-171` is already a 429 path).
  * IT WOULD HAVE REINTRODUCED THE DUPLICATE-ISSUE CLASS 21fc JUST FIXED: `_with_connection_retry`
    is the choke point for ALL 15 call sites including `create_issue`, and its docstring says
    JIRAError is unretried because "retrying a mutation on an HTTP error risks duplicates". 429
    retry is now scoped to IDEMPOTENT READS, opt-in, DEFAULTING TO OFF.
  * b586 DEPENDS ON 9263 landing (`_paged_search` is not on main yet).

*** THE SINGLE MOST USEFUL THING I LEARNED THIS SESSION ***
**THE PLAN REVIEWER READS `origin/main`, NOT YOUR BRANCH.** Twice I scored a finding as WRONG and
was wrong to: "`_paged_search` doesn't exist" (it does — on my tree; it arrives with 9263, still in
review) and "transport.py is 792 not 789" (origin/main IS 792; my post-9263 base IS 789; the delta
is 9263's own consolidation). Before disputing a plan-review finding about the CODE, check the claim
against `git show origin/main:<path>`, not just your worktree.

DO NEXT, IN ORDER
 1. Watch the four fresh runs -> Verified. Then get 1130 a fresh LLM review (maintainer action).
 2. Submit 1129/1130/1131/1136 (POST /a/changes/<n>/submit), fetch, `git merge --ff-only
    origin/main` IN THIS WORKTREE, then close 9263, 21fc, 387d, 7c26 (all bugs -> need --class).
    BEFORE closing 21fc: its plan still says the create gate lives in outbound_differ. It does NOT —
    the cap forced it into dispatch_one.create_one. Update the plan's Approach + that AC first.
    BEFORE closing 7c26: run the DC harness so its live cells report.
 3. J11 [rebar:5200] — plan review, claim, implement, LAND, RUN. THE EPIC CANNOT CLOSE WITHOUT IT.
 4. b586 round 10+ then implement; then cc77, fe15.

STANDING RULES THAT STILL BIT ME THIS SESSION
 * `rebar comment` is POSITIONAL. Verify every comment landed (byte length via `rebar show`).
 * Bugs need `--class` on close (regression|plan_defect|env_integration|flaky|preexisting|
   not_a_bug|duplicate|escalated|undetermined).
 * AFTER EDITING A PLAN, GREP THE WHOLE DOCUMENT for the term you changed. Three of b586's nine
   rounds were me fixing one section and leaving another contradicting it.
 * A full local `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler` run TIMES OUT (measured: 40 min, EXIT=124). Run
   targeted modules; let Gerrit's Verified gate be the authoritative suite signal.
 * SERIALIZE LLM gates. Another session runs in /Users/joeoakhart/rebar-wt-provider-seam.
